1_whoCanSign.answer: Only the Authorizer immutable signingAuthority — currently live BSC address 0xB6eEb3ab9695979F5b2Ef6Df4112e63212E33EE0 (Founder/DEPLOYER). Authorizer.authorityType = ERC1271 (enum 1); address has code (codesize 23). Validation: ECDSA recover if EOA, else IERC1271.isValidSignature magic value.
1_whoCanSign.rotation: Impossible without new Authorizer + new Factory deployment (both immutables)

2_whatExactDataSigned.answer: Full ExecutionIntentV1 struct under EIP-712 domain bound to (chainId, program as verifyingContract, salt from authorizer+factory+factoryVersion). Digest becomes executionId after validateExecutionIntent.

3_whatPreventsMaliciousExecutions.answer: Signature gate (only signingAuthority) + binding checks + epoch/replay + finality + reserve drift + strategy/eligible-flow math + quote floors + budget caps + atomic revert. Relayer cannot alter economics after signature; wrong calldata fails validation or reverts mid-tx.

4_canPermissionlessExecutorSubmitValidSi.answer: Yes. Any address may call Program.executeLiquidityBuilding(intent, signature) if the signature is valid for signingAuthority and all Program checks pass. Relayer does not need to be the signer or the program owner.

5_isAuthoritySeparatedFromFundsCustody.answer: Yes. Authorizer holds no tokens (view-only verifier, no custody). Program clone holds Token Reserve and executes swap/fee/LP. Owner/lpRecipient receive LP. FeeSink/FeeReceiver receive protocol fee. signingAuthority does not receive reserve or LP by virtue of signing.

6_canAiAgentSignWithoutWalletCustody.answer: Architecturally yes via non-custodial KMS/HSM or ERC-1271 smart-account module that validates agent attestations — without giving the agent Program fund custody. Practically blocked today: production path uses DisabledLiquidityBuildingKmsSigner; live signingAuthority is the Founder ERC-1271 address and is immutable. AI agent signing therefore requires a designed integration into THAT authority (or a full Factory/Authorizer redeploy), not a new parallel signer.
